- Palafin (Water) - can switch forms, strong physical
- Corviknight (Flying/Steel) - defensive, can use bodypress
- Toxapex (Poison/Water) - very defensive wall
- Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) - Prankster support or offensive

- Grimmsnarl with Prankster can set up or support
- Toxapex is a wall that needs to be handled
- Palafin can be dangerous in Hero form

1. Kingambit - Dark/Steel, good against Grimmsnarl (resists Dark, Fairy), but weak to Fighting (Palafin), Ground (Garchomp)
2. Gholdengo - Steel/Ghost, immune to Normal/Fighting (Good as Gold), resists Dragon, Fairy, Psychic. Can hit with Make It Rain. Good against Grimmsnarl, Dragapult.
3. Dragapult (mine) - Choice Scarf, very fast, can outspeed everything. Dragon Darts hits Garchomp and Dragapult. Fire Blast for Corviknight/Toxapex. U-Turn for pivoting.
4. Corviknight - Defensive, good against Fairy (Grimmsnarl), but weak to Fire, Electric
5. Clefable - Calm Mind set up, good against Dragon types (resists Dragon), but weak to Steel, Poison
6. Rotom Wash - Levitate (immune to Ground), good against Garchomp, can Will-O-Wisp physical attackers

Let me think about the best combination:

Gholdengo is excellent - immune to Fighting (Palafin's main attack), resists Dragon (Garchomp, Dragapult), Fairy (Grimmsnarl), and can hit hard with Make It Rain. Shadow Ball hits Ghost types.

My Dragapult with Choice Scarf can outspeed everything and hit Garchomp/Dragapult with Dragon Darts. Fire Blast for Corviknight/Toxapex.

Kingambit can handle Grimmsnarl well (resists Dark and Fairy), but is weak to Ground (Garchomp) and Fighting (Palafin).

Rotom Wash with Levitate is immune to Ground (Garchomp's Earthquake), can Will-O-Wisp to cripple physical attackers, and Volt Switch for pivoting. Good against Palafin too (Water resists Water).

Clefable with Calm Mind can sweep through Dragon types (resists Dragon), but is weak to Poison (Toxapex) and Steel.

I think the best combination is:
1. Gholdengo (lead) - handles most threats, immune to Fighting
2. Dragapult (Scarf) - speed control, hits Garchomp/Dragapult
3. Rotom Wash - handles Garchomp (Levitate), Palafin, can Will-O-Wisp

Actually, let me reconsider. Kingambit with Swords Dance is a great sweeper and handles Grimmsnarl well. But it's weak to Garchomp and Palafin.

I'll go with:
1. Gholdengo (lead) - great typing, immune to Fighting, resists Dragon/Fairy
2. Dragapult (Scarf) - outspeeds everything, hits Dragons
3. Rotom Wash - Levitate vs Garchomp, handles Palafin, Will-O-Wisp

This covers most threats well. Gholdengo handles Grimmsnarl and Dragapult, my Dragapult handles Garchomp and Dragapult, Rotom Wash handles Garchomp and Palafin.
